# About Pending Requests for Partners

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/about-pending-requests-partners

---

A pending request is the formal request initiated by a host or guest partner
administrator to establish a trusted cross-tenant B2B Federation relationship.
The guest submits the request and token details; the host reviews and validates
it. After the access token is verified, both the host and guest partner must
approve or deny the pending request. After approval, the request appears on the
Federated Partners page.

On **Infrastructure > B2B Federation > Federation > Partners > Pending
Requests**, administrators can add partners, filter and refresh the table,
modify columns, update request notes, approve or deny a request, cancel a
request, and navigate to Federated Partners.

The documented request-status values are **Token Verified**, **Pending
Approval**, and **Pending Verification**. The page describes the pending state
as an intermediate workflow step for auditability and controlled resource and
user access.
